lede: Chicago Bears carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#11 in EPA per play), while Seattle Seahawks owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#2 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Seattle Seahawks −3.5 with a fair total of 45.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Chicago Bears pass offence vs Seattle Seahawks pass defence, which sits −0.149 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
